description: WIP (work-in-progress) report — jobs in production, their status, costing, weights, and engaged materials
base_filter: ISNULL(MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) NOT IN (28) AND ISNULL(iStore_IsJobClosed,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(ismerged,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(isAllSplitedJobsNotMerged,0) <> 1 AND ISNULL(IsSplitProcess_NotCompleted,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(isETARejected,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(Mastermanagement_MFG_JobLastLocationid,0) IN (1,2,3,4,5) AND (ISNULL(isReverseEngage,0) <> 1 OR (ISNULL(isReverseEngage,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(REcnt,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(ReverseEngage_parent_serialjobno,'') <> ''))

size.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.mastermanagement_categoryid,0) = 1 THEN DI.Ring_FingerSize WHEN ISNULL(DI.mastermanagement_categoryid,0) = 2 THEN DI.PendentBailType WHEN ISNULL(DI.mastermanagement_categoryid,0) = 3 THEN DI.BraceletLength WHEN ISNULL(DI.mastermanagement_categoryid,0) = 4 THEN DI.BangelInsideDiameter WHEN ISNULL(DI.mastermanagement_categoryid,0) = 5 THEN DI.EaringLength WHEN ISNULL(DI.mastermanagement_categoryid,0) = 6 THEN DI.NecklaceLength WHEN ISNULL(DI.mastermanagement_categoryid,0) = 7 THEN DI.MiscellaneousFingersize ELSE DI.othersize END

department.de: CASE WHEN (ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isEngage,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isWaxEngage,0) = 0) OR (ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isEngage,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isWaxEngage,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(DI.Engage_Lastproductionstatusid,0) = 33) THEN 'Bagging Running' WHEN (ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isEngage,0) = 2 AND ISNULL(DI.isWaxEngage,0) = 0) OR (ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isEngage,0) = 2 AND ISNULL(DI.isWaxEngage,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(DI.Engage_Lastproductionstatusid,0) = 34) THEN 'Bagging Completed' WHEN (ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isWaxEngage,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isEngage,0) = 0) OR (ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isWaxEngage,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isEngage,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(DI.Engage_Lastproductionstatusid,0) = 40) THEN 'Wax Engage Running' WHEN (ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isWaxEngage,0) = 2 AND ISNULL(DI.isEngage,0) = 0) OR (ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isWaxEngage,0) = 2 AND ISNULL(DI.isEngage,0) <> 0 AND ISNULL(DI.Engage_Lastproductionstatusid,0) = 41) THEN 'Wax Engage Completed' WHEN ISNULL(DI.MasterManagement_productionstatusid,0) = 28 AND ISNULL(DI.isoutsource,0) = 1 THEN 'Out Source' ELSE ISNULL(DI.productionstatusname,'') END
department.label: Department
department.desc: Production department/status (values like Casting-Issue, setting-Issue, Pre Polish-Issue, Assembling-Receive, Pending Request). Use THIS column for 'jobs in <process>/department' questions — always with LIKE '%x%' because values carry -Issue/-Receive/-Pending suffixes.

priority.de: (SELECT ISNULL(PM.name,'') FROM {DBNAME}MasterManagement_Priority PM WHERE PM.id = DI.jobpriority)

table_dimension_exprs.ProductionManagement_SerialNoBook: (SELECT ISNULL(PM.name,'') FROM {DBNAME}MasterManagement_Priority PM WHERE PM.id = DI.jobpriority)

priority.desc: Job priority name (master lookup on jobpriority id)

Current_Departmentname.label: Current Department
Current_Departmentname.desc: Physical department name only (setting, Pre Polish, Assembling, Filing). Do NOT use for 'jobs in <process>' — prefer the computed department column.

workername.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_MiddleName,'') <> '' THEN ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_FirstName,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_MiddleName,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_LastName,'') ELSE ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_FirstName,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_LastName,'') END

LastProcessedBy.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_FirstName,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_LastName,'') <> '' THEN ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_FirstName,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(DI.AssignEmployee_LastName,'') ELSE ISNULL(DI.LastProcessedBy_Name,'') END

jobtype.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.Ismfgjob,0) = 0 THEN 'Repair Job' WHEN ISNULL(DI.REcnt,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(DI.ReverseEngage_parent_serialjobno,'') <> '' THEN 'Recast Job' WHEN (ISNULL(DI.IsSampleLineJob,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(DI.isquickrepairing,0) = 0) OR (ISNULL(DI.IsSampleLineJob,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(DI.Ismfgjob,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isquickrepairing,0) = 1) THEN 'Regular Job' WHEN (ISNULL(DI.IsSampleLineJob,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.Ismfgjob,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(DI.isquickrepairing,0) = 0) OR (ISNULL(DI.IsSampleLineJob,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.Ismfgjob,0) = 1 AND ISNULL(DI.isquickrepairing,0) = 1) THEN 'Sample Line Job' ELSE '' END
jobtype.desc: Job classification (Regular / Sample Line / Repair / Recast)

withpip.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.ismovetowip,0) = 1 THEN 'Without PIP' ELSE 'With PIP' END

Srorderno.desc: Sales order number (Sr. order no on the job)

Diamond_actualusedgm.desc: Diamond actually used in grams (ctw/5 incl. quick-repair weight)

EngagedFinding_pure.desc: Engaged finding converted to pure weight (grams)

promise_age.desc: Days from job entry to promised date (negative = promise already passed at entry)

current_age.desc: Job age in days since entry

diaColor.de: (SELECT STRING_AGG(MasterManagement_diamond_colorname,' ,') FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_designdiamonddetail WHERE MasterManagement_DiamondStoneTypeid = 1 AND QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo)
diaColor.desc: Diamond colour(s) from the job quotation

diaQuality.de: (SELECT STRING_AGG(Quality,' ,') FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_designdiamonddetail WHERE MasterManagement_DiamondStoneTypeid = 1 AND QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo)
diaQuality.desc: Diamond quality(ies) from the job quotation

engage_productionstatusname.desc: Engaged production stage name (process the job is engaged in)

IsCompanyJob.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.IsCompanyJob,0) = 1 THEN 'Sales Order' ELSE '' END
IsCompanyJob.desc: Sales-order flag ('Sales Order' when the job came from a company/sales order)

QuotationNo.desc: Quotation number the job was created from (empty = direct job)

has_quotation.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'') <> '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
has_quotation.desc: Whether the job was created from a quotation

Total_DiamondPcs_quot.me: ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.totaldiamondpcs FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(MasterManagement_DiamondStoneTypeid,0)=1 THEN ISNULL([pieces],0)+ISNULL(pieces_SizeWise,0) ELSE 0 END) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_designdiamonddetail WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0))) * IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), 1, ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0)), 0)
Total_DiamondPcs_quot.desc: Required diamond pieces from design/quotation (pcs x job qty)

Total_CsPcs_quot.me: ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.totalcolorstonepcs FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(MasterManagement_DiamondStoneTypeid,0)=2 THEN ISNULL([pieces],0)+ISNULL(pieces_SizeWise,0) ELSE 0 END) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_designdiamonddetail WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0))) * IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), 1, ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0)), 0)

Total_miscPcs_quot.me: ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.totalmiscpcs FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(MasterManagement_DiamondStoneTypeid,0)=3 THEN ISNULL([pieces],0)+ISNULL(pieces_SizeWise,0) ELSE 0 END) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_designdiamonddetail WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0))) * IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), 1, ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0)), 0)

Total_DiamondCtw_quot.me: ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.totaldiamondweight FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(MasterManagement_DiamondStoneTypeid,0)=1 THEN ISNULL([GrossDiamondWeight],0) ELSE 0 END) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_designdiamonddetail WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0))) * IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), 1, ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0)), 0)
Total_DiamondCtw_quot.desc: Required diamond weight (ctw, with loss) from design/quotation

Total_CSCtw_quot.me: ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.totalcolorstoneweight FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(MasterManagement_DiamondStoneTypeid,0)=2 THEN ISNULL([Weight],0)+ISNULL(weight_SizeWise,0) ELSE 0 END) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_designdiamonddetail WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0))) * IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), 1, ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0)), 0)
Total_CSCtw_quot.desc: Required colourstone weight (ctw, with loss) from design/quotation

Total_miscCtw_quot.me: ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.totalmiscweight FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(MasterManagement_DiamondStoneTypeid,0)=3 THEN ISNULL([Weight],0)+ISNULL(weight_SizeWise,0) ELSE 0 END) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_designdiamonddetail WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0))) * IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), 1, ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0)), 0)
Total_miscCtw_quot.desc: Required misc-stone weight (ctw, with loss) from design/quotation

GrossWeight_quot.me: CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.ActualGrossweight FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), (ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GrossWeight) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_dcbdesignInfo WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0) * ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0))))

NetWt_quot.me: CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.MetalWeight FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), (ISNULL((SELECT SUM(netwt) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_dcbdesignInfo WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0) * ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0))))

Total_PurWt_quot.me: ISNULL({DBNAME}dbo.fn_get_source_remaning_metalctw(ISNULL(DI.metal_purity_name,''), CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), IIF((ISNULL(DI.iStore_QuotationNo,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.IsQuickRepairing,0)=1 AND ISNULL(DI.IsMFGJob,0)=0), ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 D.MetalWeight FROM {DBNAME}designmanagement_design D WHERE D.designno = DI.Designcode),0), (ISNULL((SELECT SUM(netwt) FROM {DBNAME}Quotationmanagement_dcbdesignInfo WHERE QuotationNo = DI.iStore_QuotationNo),0) * ISNULL(DI.IsSplits_Quotation_Quantity,0)))), ISNULL(DI.metal_type_name,''), 'pure'), 0)

IsQuickRepairing.desc: Boolean: is this a quick repair job?

ismfgjob.desc: Boolean: is this a manufacturing job?

isDeliveryBatchJob.desc: Boolean: is this a delivery batch job?

ismovetowip.desc: Boolean: moved to WIP (1 = Without PIP)

salesrep_master_customercode.de: (SELECT ISNULL(U.customercode,'') FROM {DBNAME}Usermanagement_systemloginmaster U WHERE U.id = DI.customer_salesrep_id)

week.de: CONVERT(varchar(4), YEAR(DI.jobentrydate)) + '-W' + RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, DI.jobentrydate)), 2)

unique_designs.description: Count of unique designs in progress

unique_customers.description: Count of unique customers with WIP jobs

special_rules: WIP report covers jobs in progress (not closed, not merged, not outsource-status-28, not ETA-rejected). Do NOT include closed jobs.
Job status/department is a computed dimension derived from productionstatusid + isEngage + isWaxEngage flags. Use 'department' for production-stage questions.
JobCost is the total cost of a WIP job (metal + diamond + colourstone + making + findings + misc). Use JobCost for 'total WIP value/cost' questions.
Weights are in grams (GrossWeightgm, NetWtgm, PureWt, EngagedFinding) except diamond/colourstone/misc which are in carat (Diamond_actualused, ColorStone_actualused, misc_actualused).
issue_age1 is hours since issue/entry (higher = older job). issue_age2 is days until expected start (negative = overdue). Use these for aging/delay questions.
jobtype dimension classifies jobs as: Regular Job, Sample Line Job, Repair Job, Recast Job.
negative_examples: total tax -> NOT applicable to WIP (no tax columns)
sales amount -> NOT applicable to WIP (use JobCost for total WIP value)
